<html:h1 data-l10n-id="general-email-notifications-header"/>
    </hbox>

    <html:div data-category="paneGeneral">
    <html:fieldset data-category="paneGeneral">
      <html:legend data-l10n-id="new-message-arrival-legend"></html:legend>
#if defined(XP_MACOSX) || defined(XP_WIN)
      <hbox align="center">
        <description flex="1" data-l10n-id="change-dock-icon-description"/>
        <hbox>
          <button is="highlightable-button" id="dockOptions"
                  oncommand="gGeneralPane.configureDockOptions();"
                  data-l10n-id="app-icon-options"
                  search-l10n-ids="
                    dock-icon-notification-dialog-title,
                    dock-icon-animate-label.label,
                    dock-icon-legend,
                    dock-badge-show-label.value,
                    total-unread-messages-radio.label,
                    total-new-messages-radio.label,
                    notification-badge-system-info"/>
        </hbox>
      </hbox>
#endif
      <hbox align="center">
        <checkbox id="newMailNotificationAlert"
                  data-l10n-id="new-email-alert-label"
                  preference="mail.biff.show_alert"/>
        <spacer flex="1"/>
        <hbox>
          <button is="highlightable-button" id="customizeMailAlert"
                  oncommand="gGeneralPane.customizeMailAlert();"
                  data-l10n-id="customize-alerts-label"
                  search-l10n-ids="
                    notifications-dialog-title,
                    customize-alert-description,
                    preview-text-checkbox.label,
                    subject-checkbox.label,
                    sender-checkbox.label,
                    open-time-label-before.value,
                    open-time-label-after.value"/>
        </hbox>
      </hbox>
#ifndef XP_MACOSX
      <hbox align="center" class="indent">
        <checkbox id="useSystemNotificationAlert"
                  data-l10n-id="biff-use-system-alert"
                  preference="mail.biff.use_system_alert"/>
      </hbox>
